The result is transcripts that are as close to perfect as possible, so you spend less time editing and more time focusing on what matters the most. How accurate is Good Tape? Transcription that speaks your language Whether you are covering an international press conference or recording interviews abroad, Good Tape handles the workflow seamlessly. We work across borders to ensure high-level accuracy no matter the language you’re working in, allowing you to generate accurate AI transcripts exactly when you need them. With multilingual transcription in 100+ languages as a core feature, you can transcribe recordings in any language you encounter (also smaller languages). We provide fast and accurate transcription for global teams who need reliable AI-powered transcription. Discover supported languages Recorder app for iOS and Android The Good Tape app for iOS and Android provides professional transcription eliminating the need for secondary recorders or manual file transfers. Record high-quality audio directly within the app. Recordings are instantly synced to your Good Tape account, ready for transcription the moment you finish speaking. This streamlined workflow is backed by the same ISO 27001 certified security and GDPR-compliant encryption that professionals have come to trust, ensuring sensitive interviews remain protected. Download Good Tape app here Secure automated AI transcription Secure compliant transcription is the fundamental requirement for any professional handling sensitive, or. private audio recordings. We believe that your data is not our business. All transcription files are stored securely in the EU, fully GDPR-compliant, and ISO 27001 certified. Unlike other transcription tools, we never train AI models on your data. Good Tape is more than secure transcription software. We are a company committed to privacy, transparency, and the highest ethical standards. Read more below. It all lands in Good Tape. Record interviews in the field with the Good Tape app, upload the files from your digital recorder, let the notetaker sit in on your online meetings, or stream audio straight from your own systems through the API while the conversation is still running. Encrypted the moment it leaves the device. Recorder app API 02 / Transcription Seconds later, the transcript is ready. Good Tape transcribes in 100+ languages, Danish, Norwegian, Swedish and Finnish included, detects every voice and labels the speakers automatically. Rename a speaker once and the whole file follows. Time-coded, searchable and ready to work with. Speaker labels 03 / AI steps Summaries and action points, with time codes. One click turns a two-hour recording into a structured overview and a list of action points, each tied to the moment it came from. No third-party model ever sees your audio. AI summaries 04 / Archive Every file joins your archive. Each transcript is added to your own library of everything you have ever recorded. Group files by client, story or case with Projects. Files in a folder are storage. An archive that knows what they say is memory. Projects Try it with your own recording 05 / Explore: topics and insights Good Tape understands all of it. Explore reads your whole archive and names the themes that keep coming back, each one traceable to the exact moments it came from. Pin the topics that matter, add your own, and ask the archive a question. Every answer arrives with its source. Good Tape Explore 06 / Explore: back in the transcript Open a transcript. Enrich it from your archive. While you read, Explore pulls the relevant passages from other recordings into the margin: the claim a source made last year, the number a colleague heard in March. Every insight carries the file, the timestamp and the transcript behind it. Read more about Explore 07 / Explore: chat Chat with your tapes. Get answers with sources. Ask for the strongest quotes, a headline, a brief, or what else in your archive relates to this recording. Every answer names the transcript and the timestamp it came from, so you can check it against the tape. Runs on an EU-hosted model and never touches big tech. Read more about Explore 08 / Projects and collaboration Add it to a project. Share it with colleagues. Put the transcript in a project and invite a colleague. A transcript is private until its owner shares it, and a share can be revoked at any time. Not even a team owner can read what was never shared. Good Tape for teams Explore for teams 09 / Privacy and security All of this, inside one private, secure environment. Your recordings and transcripts are never used to train any model. We process and store your data only on servers inside the EU, encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. We hold ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and we built Good Tape to GDPR requirements. See our full security and compliance approach Talk to us about compliance 10 / Connect Connects to the tools you already run. The Good Tape MCP is a read-only door between your archive and Claude, ChatGPT, Mistral or any AI tool that supports MCP, including the AI system your organisation runs in-house. It is off by default. Search, retrieve and draft without copy-pasting a single transcript. And through integrations, Good Tape works directly inside your media asset management system. See all 100+ languages Recording app for iOS and Android With the Good Tape recording app, you can also capture high-quality audio directly from your phone. Designed for iOS and Android, the app lets you record interviews, lectures, or meetings, syncs the recording with your Good Tape account and transcribes automatically. Never upload a file again. Just hit record. We’ve got the rest. Download for iOS or Android below today. *Good Tape still accepts all file formats. Get the recorder app Editing: Intuitive transcript editor No more clunky tools or endless scrolling. Good Tape’s editor is designed to be intuitive, fast, and accurate. Clean up transcripts, correct minor errors, and highlight key passages effortlessly. Whether you’re polishing an interview for publication or preparing notes for court, the editor helps you finish your work faster without distraction. Speaker labels: Clarity in conversations Speaker Labels show you who said what. Once you can see who said what, you can assign the names. Labels sit at the core of a usable transcript. If they are wrong, you re-listen to the whole thing. Speaker labels come with every transcription, at no extra cost and with nothing to switch on. See how speaker labels work AI summaries: Insights and overview Going through a full transcript can take as long as replaying the recording itself. It’s slow, exhausting, and rarely what you actually need. That’s why we built AI summaries. With one click, Good Tape turns your transcript into a clean overview of key points, themes, and insights. So instead of spending hours reading, you can understand the story in minutes. See a summary example See pricing Projects: Organize your tapes with ease Transcripts pile up quickly. That’s why Good Tape includes Projects, an easy way to group your recordings and transcripts into folders. Keep projects organized by topic, client, or date, so you never waste time searching for the file you need. Projects give you a clean workspace, especially when you’re managing dozens of ongoing projects. See how projects work Audio playback: Follow every word you hear Every transcript is linked to its audio source, making it easy to reference the original recording. Simply click on a word in the text, and playback begins from that exact moment (with time codes if needed). Whether you’re double-checking a quote for an article or verifying an interview response, playback keeps you connected to the source without endless rewinds. See playback in action Bulk uploads: Save hours on large projects When you have dozens of recordings to get through, upload them all in one go. Bulk uploads let you process multiple files in a single session, cutting down time spent managing files and freeing you to focus on analysis. It’s an essential feature for researchers, media teams , and organizations working with high volumes of audio or video. See how bulk upload works Export subtitles: Make content accessible Turn your transcripts into subtitles in just a few clicks. Whether you’re producing podcasts, webinars, films, or lectures, exporting subtitles makes your content accessible to wider audiences and improves discoverability. With Good Tape, you can generate .srt or .vtt files instantly, ready for upload to YouTube, Vimeo, or your own platform. Export .srt and .vtt Teams: sharing and collaboration Sometimes you need to share a transcript with a colleague or client, but you don’t want multiple people editing the same file simultaneously. Good Tape’s Team Sharing option makes it simple: share the file, give access, and let others review the content

Get started Transcription for newsrooms Zetland is a respected award-winning digital newspaper under the Bonnier umbrella. They use Good Tape daily across thier newsroom. With dozens of journalists handling interviews, podcasts, and stories, Good Tape turned transcription from a dreaded bottleneck into a competitive advantage, saving the organization thousands of man hours per year. Listen to Zetland CEO (and Good Tape chairperson) Tav Klitgaard reflect on Good Tape and the role of transcription in their organization.
